## Outcome

Most of this week was cleanup and waiting for maintainer decisions. I kept the renderer work small and stopped expanding the two CI proposals while their ownership was still unclear.

## What I Did

- Kept [PR #306](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/306) limited to removing redundant selector checks without changing behavior.
- Paused further expansion of PR #338 and PR #341 while waiting for feedback about where those fixes belonged.
- Kept PR #339 separate because it changed visible facet rendering rather than CI infrastructure.

## Learnings

The clearest version of PR #306 was also the smallest one. Adding another feature or a workflow policy would only have made the review harder.

## Challenges / Notes

There was no large public milestone. The useful result was a smaller branch and a clearer separation between renderer work and infrastructure questions.

## Next Week Targets

Finish the PR #306 review and act on the maintainer feedback for PR #338 and PR #341.
